description: Na₃CoO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.55 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.49 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.75 Å. Co is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.77 Å) and one longer (1.78 Å) Co-O bond length. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Co octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Co atom.
